content_sections.heading: Central Silk Board Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies are available - 2 for Joint Secretary (Technical), 4 for Deputy Director (Admn. & Accts.), 1 for Deputy Director (Statistics), 1 for Deputy Director (Official Language), 1 for Deputy Director (Finance), 6 for Assistant Director (Admn. & Accts.), 1 for Assistant Director (Statistics), and 1 for Assistant Engineer.

content_sections.heading: Central Silk Board Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Joint Secretary (Technical): Officers of Central or State Government holding analogous posts or 5 years in Level-11. Deputy Director (Admn. & Accts.): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 5 years in Level-10 with Bachelor's degree. Deputy Director (Statistics): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 5 years in Level-10 with Bachelor's degree in Statistics. Deputy Director (Official Language): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 5 years in Level-10 with Master's degree in Hindi/English and translation diploma. Deputy Director (Finance): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 5 years in Level-10 with CA/Cost Accountant/CS/MBA/M.Com. Assistant Director (Admn. & Accts.): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 3 years in Level-7 with CA/Cost Accountant/CS/MBA/M.Com. Assistant Director (Statistics): Officers of Central Government holding analogous posts or 3 years in Level-7 with Bachelor's degree in Statistics. Assistant Engineer: Officials holding analogous post with II Class Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Central Silk Board Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://csb.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Silk Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Central Silk Board Various Posts on Deputation is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Central Silk Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available for various posts on deputation in the Central Silk Board Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Central Silk Board posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, including Bachelor's degree, Master's degree in Statistics/Hindi/English/Commerce, CA/Cost Accountant/CS/MBA, and II Class B.E. Civil.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Central Silk Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Central Silk Board posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 35400 to Rs. 209200 Per Month, depending on the post and its corresponding pay level.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Central Silk Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening followed by a Personal Discussion.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Central Silk Board: http://csb.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Which government departments are eligible for deputation?
faq.answer: Officers from Central or State Government departments holding analogous posts or meeting specific service/level requirements are eligible for deputation.
